articles.title: Parkrun and the Olympic Legacy
articles.topic: 公园跑与奥运遗产：草根体育为何比奥运会更成功
articles.source: 2017 年考研英语（二）Text 1 · 原文与答案依据真题及解析 PDF

sentences.en: Every Saturday morning, at 9 am, more than 50,000 runners set off to run 5km around their local park.
sentences.cn: 每周六上午 9 点，超过 5 万名跑步者开始绕当地公园跑 5 千米。

sentences.en: The Parkrun phenomenon began with a dozen friends and has inspired 400 events in the UK and more abroad.
sentences.cn: “公园跑”现象始于十来个朋友，如今已在英国激起 400 场活动，国外更多。

sentences.en: Events are free, staffed by thousands of volunteers.
sentences.cn: 活动免费，工作人员由数千名志愿者担任。

sentences.en: Runners range from four years old to grandparents; their times range from Andrew Baddeley's world record 13 minutes 48 seconds up to an hour.
sentences.cn: 跑步者年龄下起 4 岁的幼童，上至祖父母之辈；他们的成绩最短的是安德鲁·巴德利 13 分 48 秒的世界纪录，最长的高达一小时之久。

sentences.en: Parkrun is succeeding where London's Olympic "legacy" is failing.
sentences.cn: “公园跑”的成功之处正是伦敦奥运会“遗产”的失败之处。

sentences.en: Ten years ago on Monday, it was announced that the Games of the 30th Olympiad would be in London.
sentences.cn: 十年前的那个星期一，（国际奥委会）宣布第 30 届奥林匹克运动会将在伦敦举行。

words.meaning: n. 奥林匹克运动会（届）

sentences.en: Planning documents pledged that the great legacy of the Games would be to lever a nation of sport lovers away from their couches.
sentences.cn: 规划文件承诺，奥运会的伟大遗产将会是把全国的体育爱好者撬离沙发。

sentences.en: The population would be fitter, healthier and produce more winners.
sentences.cn: 国民将会更强壮，更健康，产生更多获胜者。

words.meaning: adj. 更健康的（fit 比较级）

sentences.en: It has not happened.
sentences.cn: 但这并没有发生。

sentences.en: The number of adults doing weekly sport did rise, by nearly 2 million in the run-up to 2012 - but the general population was growing faster.
sentences.cn: 在 2012 年前的筹备阶段，每周参加体育运动的成年人数量确实上升了，增加了近 200 万——但总人口增长得更快。

sentences.en: Worse, the numbers are now falling at an accelerating rate.
sentences.cn: 更糟糕的是，这一数字如今正以加速的势头下降。

sentences.en: The opposition claims primary school pupils doing at least two hours of sport a week have nearly halved.
sentences.cn: 反对党声称，每周至少参加两小时体育运动的小学生人数已近乎减半。

sentences.en: Obesity has risen among adults and children.
sentences.cn: 成年人和儿童中的肥胖率均有所上升。

sentences.en: Official retrospections continue as to why London 2012 failed to "inspire a generation."
sentences.cn: 关于 2012 年伦敦奥运会为何未能“激励一代人”，官方的反思仍在继续。

sentences.en: The success of Parkrun offers answers.
sentences.cn: “公园跑”的成功给出了答案。

sentences.en: Parkun is not a race but a time trial: Your only competitor is the clock.
sentences.cn: “公园跑”不是竞赛，而是计时赛：你唯一的竞争对手便是时间。

sentences.en: The ethos welcomes anybody.
sentences.cn: 其精神在于欢迎任何人。

sentences.en: There is as much joy over a puffed-out first-timer being clapped over the line as there is about top talent shining.
sentences.cn: 气喘吁吁的初次参加者在掌声中跨过终点时，获得的快乐与光芒四射的顶尖天才一样多。

sentences.en: The Olympic bidders, by contrast, wanted to get more people doing sport and to produce more elite athletes.
sentences.cn: 相比之下，奥运会申办者则希望让更多人参与运动且产生更多的精英运动员。

sentences.en: The dual aim was mixed up: The stress on success over taking part was intimidating for newcomers.
sentences.cn: 双重目的被混为一谈：强调“成功”胜过“参与”会吓退新手。

sentences.en: Indeed, there is something a little absurd in the state getting involved in the planning of such a fundamentally "grassroots" concept as community sports associations.
sentences.cn: 的确，政府参与规划“社区体育协会”这样本质上“草根”的概念有点荒唐。

sentences.en: If there is a role for government, it should really be getting involved in providing common goods - making sure there is space for playing fields and the money to pave tennis and netball courts, and encouraging the provision of all these activities in schools.
sentences.cn: 如果政府要起点作用，那其实应该是努力提供公共物品——确保有运动场地的空间，有铺筑网球、篮网球场的资金，并支持学校开展所有这些体育活动。

sentences.en: But successive governments have presided over selling green spaces, squeezing money from local authorities and declining attention on sport in education.
sentences.cn: 但是历届政府却一直掌管着售卖绿地，压缩地方政府资金，拒绝重视教育领域的体育运动。

sentences.en: Instead of wordy, worthy strategies, future governments need to do more to provide the conditions for sport to thrive.
sentences.cn: 未来政府不是要制定冗长的、令人尊敬的策略，而是需要多干实事，为繁荣体育运动提供条件。

words.meaning: adj. 有价值的，值得尊敬的

sentences.en: Or at least not make them worse.
sentences.cn: 或者至少不要让情况变得更糟。

questions.stem: According to Paragraph 1, Parkrun has ___.
questions.stem_cn: 根据第一段，“公园跑”已___。
questions.explanation: 第一段指出公园跑每周定时举行、人数超5万，始于十来个朋友如今激起400场活动、国外更多，且志愿者众多、参加者老少皆有；再由第二段首句 Parkrun is succeeding 印证，可知该活动已赢得巨大欢迎，故 [A] 正确。[B] 志愿者非“岗位”，[C] 断章取义，[D] 反向干扰。

questions.stem: The author believes that London's Olympic "legacy" has failed to ___.
questions.stem_cn: 作者认为伦敦奥运会“遗产”未能___。
questions.explanation: 第二段指出奥运遗产本预期促进国民参与运动、更健康，结果却是运动人数下降、肥胖人数增加，可见其未能提升运动参与，故 [B] 正确。

questions.stem: Parkrun is different from Olympic games in that it ___.
questions.stem_cn: “公园跑”不同于“奥运会”之处在于它___。
questions.explanation: 第三段由 by contrast 指出：公园跑旨在让所有人参与并获得快乐，而奥运会既求大众参与又求发现精英，两者区别在于公园跑不强调“精英主义”，故 [C] 正确。

questions.stem: With regard to mass sports, the author holds that governments should ___.
questions.stem_cn: 关于大众体育，作者认为政府应该___。

options_cn.C: 增加对体育俱乐部的投资

questions.explanation: 第四段指出政府就促进大众体育的正确做法应是提供公共物品：确保运动场地、提供铺场资金、支持学校开展活动，即投资公共体育设施，故 [D] 正确。

questions.stem: The author's attitude to what UK governments have done for sports is ___.
questions.stem_cn: 作者对英国政府在体育方面所作所为的态度是___。
questions.explanation: 第四段指出政府参与规划基层体育有些可笑，实际做法（卖绿地、压缩资金、忽视校内体育）与正确做法完全相反，末句敦促未来政府多干实事、至少别更糟，可见作者持明显批判态度，故 [B] 正确。

articles.title: Parents, Screens, and Attention
articles.topic: 父母的屏幕使用：数字设备如何冲击亲子互动
articles.source: 2017 年考研英语（二）Text 2 · 原文与答案依据真题及解析 PDF

sentences.en: With so much focus on children's use of screens, it's easy for parents to forget about their own screen use.
sentences.cn: 随着儿童使用数字产品备受关注，父母很容易忽视他们自己对数字产品的使用。

sentences.en: "Tech is designed to really suck you in," says Jenny Radesky in her study of digital play, "and digital products are there to promote maximal engagement."
sentences.cn: “科技旨在真正让你卷入其中，”珍妮·拉德斯基在她的数字消遣研究中说道，“而且数字产品是为了促进最大参与度。”

words.meaning: 把你卷入其中，吸引住你

sentences.en: It makes it hard to disengage, and leads to a lot of bleed-over into the family routine.
sentences.cn: 这种沉迷使人很难脱身，而且大量渗透到家庭日常生活中。

sentences.en: Radesky has studied the use of mobile phones and tablets at mealtimes by giving mother-child pairs a food-testing exercise.
sentences.cn: 通过让多对母子参与食物测试任务，拉德斯基研究了进餐时段手机和平板电脑的使用情况。

sentences.en: She found that mothers who used devices during the exercise started 20 per cent fewer verbal and 39 per cent fewer nonverbal interactions with their children.
sentences.cn: 她发现，在任务期间使用数字设备的母亲与孩子进行语言交流的频率降低了 20%，进行非语言交流的频率降低了 39%。

sentences.en: During a separate observation, she saw that phones became a source of tension in the family.
sentences.cn: 在另外一次观察中，她发现手机成了家庭紧张关系的根源。

sentences.en: Parents would be looking at their emails while the children would be making excited bids for their attention.
sentences.cn: 当孩子们紧张不安地企图获得父母的注意时，父母们却在查看电子邮件。

sentences.en: Infants are wired to look at parents' faces to try to understand their world, and if those faces are blank and unresponsive - as they often are when absorbed in a device - it can be extremely disconcerting for the children.
sentences.cn: 婴幼儿生来就靠观察父母的面孔来理解世界，如果这些面孔毫无表情也无任何反应——就像他们沉浸在数字设备时经常就是如此——这会让孩子感到非常不安。

sentences.en: Radesky cites the "still face experiment" devised by developmental psychologist Ed Tronick in the 1970s.
sentences.cn: 拉德斯基引用了 20 世纪 70 年代发展心理学家爱德华·特罗尼克设计的“面无表情实验”。

sentences.en: In it, a mother is asked to interact with her child in a normal way before putting on a blank expression and not giving them any visual social feedback: The child becomes increasingly distressed as she tries to capture her mother's attention.
sentences.cn: 在实验中，母亲被要求先以正常方式与孩子交流，之后摆出一副面无表情的神情并且不给孩子任何视觉上的社交反馈：孩子会因试图获得母亲的注意而变得越来越痛苦。

sentences.en: "Parents don't have to be exquisitely present at all times, but there needs to be a balance and parents need to be responsive and sensitive to a child's verbal or nonverbal expressions of an emotional need," says Radesky.
sentences.cn: “父母不必时刻都无微不至地陪伴，但需要有一种平衡，父母需要对孩子言语或非言语的情感需求作出回应并保持敏感，”拉德斯基说道。

sentences.en: On the other hand, Tronick himself is concerned that the worries about kids' use of screens are born out of an "oppressive ideology that demands that parents should always be interacting" with their children:
sentences.cn: 另一方面，特罗尼克自己担心对于孩子们使用数字产品的各种担忧是出于一种“要求父母一直与孩子保持交流的压制性的意识形态”：

sentences.en: "It's based on a somewhat fantasised, very white, very upper-middle-class ideology that says if you're failing to expose your child to 30,000 words you are neglecting them."
sentences.cn: “它基于一种有点儿幻想成分、非常符合白人和中上阶层价值观念的意识形态，认为如果你与孩子的语言交流未达到 3 万词汇，你就是在忽视他们。”

sentences.en: Tronick believes that just because a child isn't learning from the screen doesn't mean there's no value to it - particularly if it gives parents time to have a shower, do housework or simply have a break from their child.
sentences.cn: 特罗尼克认为，仅仅因为孩子没有从数字产品上学到东西并不意味着它没有任何价值——特别是如果它能让父母有时间去洗澡、做家务或只是暂时离开孩子休息一下。

sentences.en: Parents, he says, can get a lot out of using their devices to speak to a friend or get some work out of the way.
sentences.cn: 他说道，父母们可以从使用数字设备与朋友交谈或者处理完一些工作中获益良多。

words.w: get some work out of the way

sentences.en: This can make them feel happier, which lets them be more available to their child the rest of the time.
sentences.cn: 这能使他们感到更加幸福，让他们在其余时间里更有闲暇陪伴孩子。

questions.stem: According to Jenny Radesky, digital products are designed to ___.
questions.stem_cn: 根据詹妮·拉德斯基的观点，数字产品的设计初衷在于___。
questions.explanation: 首段②③句指出拉德斯基观点：科技旨在把你真正卷入其中，数字产品是为促进最大参与度，使人难以自拔。可见其设计初衷在于吸引用户注意力，故 [B] 正确。

questions.stem: Radesky's food-testing exercise shows that mothers' use of devices ___.
questions.stem_cn: 拉德斯基的食物测试任务表明，母亲使用（数字）设备会___。
questions.explanation: 第二段②句指出食物测试发现：使用数字设备的母亲与孩子的语言交流减少20%、非语言交流减少39%，可见母亲使用设备会减少与孩子的交流，故 [D] 正确。

questions.stem: Radesky cites the "still face experiment" to show that ___.
questions.stem_cn: 拉德斯基引用“面无表情实验”是为了表明___。

options.A: it is easy for children to get used to blank expressions
options.B: verbal expressions are unnecessary for emotional exchange
options.C: children are insensitive to changes in their parents' mood
options.D: parents need to respond to children's emotional needs

options_cn.A: 孩子很容易对面无表情习以为常
options_cn.B: 语言表达对于情感交流并非必须
options_cn.C: 孩子对父母的情绪变化不敏感
options_cn.D: 父母需要回应孩子的情感需求

questions.explanation: 第三段②③句借实验说明父母面无表情会令孩子越来越苦恼，④句提出拉德斯基观点：父母应积极回应孩子的情感诉求。可见其意在提醒父母回应孩子的情感需求，故 [D] 正确。

questions.stem: The oppressive ideology mentioned by Tronick requires parents to ___.
questions.stem_cn: 特罗尼克所提及的“压制性意识形态”要求父母___。

options.A: protect kids from exposure to wild fantasies
options.B: teach their kids at least 30,000 words a year
options.C: ensure constant interaction with their children
options.D: remain concerned about kids' use of screens

options_cn.A: 保护孩子免受狂乱幻想的影响
options_cn.B: 每年至少教给孩子3万个词汇
options_cn.C: 确保与孩子一直保持互动
options_cn.D: 一直关心孩子对数字产品的使用

questions.explanation: 第四段①句指出，压制性意识形态要求父母必须一直与孩子保持互动（should always be interacting），故 [C] 正确。[B] 3万词汇是该意识形态的论调，非其“要求”本身。

questions.stem: According to Tronick, kids' use of screens may ___.
questions.stem_cn: 根据特罗尼克的观点，孩子使用数字产品可以___。

options.A: give their parents some free time

options_cn.B: 让他们的父母更富有创造力

questions.explanation: 第四段指出，特罗尼克认为孩子使用数字产品并非全无好处：它能让父母有时间洗澡、做家务或稍作休息，即给父母一些自由时间，故 [A] 正确。

articles.title: In Favor of the Gap Year
articles.topic: 为间隔年正名：休整一年为何有助于学业与省钱
articles.source: 2017 年考研英语（二）Text 3 · 原文与答案依据真题及解析 PDF

sentences.en: Today, widespread social pressure to immediately go to college in conjunction with increasingly high expectations in a fast-moving world often causes students to completely overlook the possibility of taking a gap year.
sentences.cn: 如今，（高中毕业后）即刻升入大学这一普遍社会压力，加之快速发展的世界（对人们）越来越高的期望，往往导致学生们完全忽略了经历间隔年这一选择。

sentences.en: After all, if everyone you know is going to college in the fall, it seems silly to stay back a year, doesn't it?
sentences.cn: 毕竟，如果你认识的每个人都将在秋季步入大学，你一个人延迟一年入学似乎很傻，不是吗？

sentences.en: And after going to school for 12 years, it doesn't feel natural to spend a year doing something that isn't academic.
sentences.cn: 而且在上了 12 年学之后，花一年时间做学习之外的事也感觉不大正常。

sentences.en: But while this may be true, it's not a good enough reason to condemn gap years.
sentences.cn: 但这即使是事实，也不足以成为谴责间隔年的理由。

sentences.en: There's always a constant fear of falling behind everyone else on the socially perpetuated "race to the finish line," whether that be toward graduate school, medical school or a lucrative career.
sentences.cn: 在全社会一直延续着“向终点冲刺的比赛”，无论终点是研究生院、医学院还是赚钱的职业，人们永远有一种落于人后的担忧。

sentences.en: But despite common misconceptions, a gap year does not hinder the success of academic pursuits - in fact, it probably enhances it.
sentences.cn: 然而，尽管存在许多误解，间隔年其实不会阻碍学术事业的成功——实际上，它很可能助人成功。

sentences.en: Studies from the United States and Australia show that students who take a gap year are generally better prepared for and perform better in college than those who do not.
sentences.cn: 美国和澳大利亚的研究表明，经历过间隔年的学生普遍比没经历过间隔年的学生对大学有更充分的准备，表现也更好。

sentences.en: Rather than pulling students back, a gap year pushes them ahead by preparing them for independence, new responsibilities and environmental changes - all things that first-year students often struggle with the most.
sentences.cn: 间隔年不仅不会使学生退步，反而能让学生在独立、新的责任和环境变化方面——这些都是一年级学生往往最为纠结的事情——做好更充分的准备，从而助其进步。

sentences.en: Gap year experiences can lessen the blow when it comes to adjusting to college and being thrown into a brand new environment, making it easier to focus on academics and activities rather than acclimation blunders.
sentences.cn: 间隔年经历可以减轻适应大学生活和陷入全新环境所带来的冲击，使学生更容易专注于学业和活动，而不必为适应问题分心。

sentences.en: If you're not convinced of the inherent value in taking a year off to explore interests, then consider its financial impact on future academic choices.
sentences.cn: 如果你不相信休学一年具有发掘兴趣的内在价值，那么就想想它对于未来学业选择的经济影响吧。

sentences.en: According to the National Center for Education Statistics, nearly 80 percent of college students end up changing their majors at least once.
sentences.cn: 根据（美国）国家教育统计中心的数据，约 80% 的大学生最后都至少转过一次专业。

sentences.en: This isn't surprising, considering the basic mandatory high school curriculum leaves students with a poor understanding of the vast academic possibilities that await them in college.
sentences.cn: 鉴于高中强制性基础课程使学生对于大学里广阔的学术选择知之甚少，这并不奇怪。

sentences.en: Many students find themselves listing one major on their college applications, but switching to another after taking college classes.
sentences.cn: 许多学生发现自己在大学申请书中填报了一个专业，上过大学课程之后却转到了另一个专业。

sentences.en: It's not necessarily a bad thing, but depending on the school, it can be costly to make up credits after switching too late in the game.
sentences.cn: 这并不一定是坏事，但是根据学校的不同，由于转专业太晚，补学分的费用可能会很高。

sentences.en: At Boston College, for example, you would have to complete an extra year were you to switch to the nursing school from another department.
sentences.cn: 例如，在波士顿学院，如果你要从其他院系转到护理学院的话，就必须再多读一年。

sentences.en: Taking a gap year to figure things out initially can help prevent stress and save money later on.
sentences.cn: 选择间隔年一开始就把事情理顺有助于预防压力，之后还能省钱。

questions.stem: One of the reasons for high-school graduates not taking a gap year is that ___.
questions.stem_cn: 高中毕业生不选择间隔年的一个原因是___。

options.B: they have a lot of fun to expect in college
options.C: it feels strange to do differently from others
options.D: it seems worthless to take off-campus courses

options_cn.A: 他们认为它在学业上误人子弟
options_cn.B: 他们对大学许多乐趣有所期待
options_cn.C: 做法和其他人不一样令人不安
options_cn.D: 修读校外课程似乎没什么价值

questions.explanation: 首段②③句补充主观原因：周围人都直入大学，独自延迟显得愚蠢；连读12年书突然休整一年感觉“有违常理”，[C] 正确概括了这种从众心理。

questions.stem: Studies from the US and Australia imply that taking a gap year helps ___.
questions.stem_cn: 美国和澳大利亚的研究表明，选择间隔年有助于___。
questions.explanation: 第三段借美、澳研究指出间隔年能帮学生更顺利地适应大学、应对多数新生最头疼的问题，相当于大学预演使其提前受磨炼，从而减轻适应新环境的压力，故 [D] 正确。

questions.stem: The word "acclimation" (Para. 3) is closest in meaning to ___.
questions.stem_cn: 第三段中的“acclimation”一词词义最接近___。
questions.explanation: 所考词出现于第三段末句，与“专注学业”相对，指“牵绊于学业之外的问题”，结合上文“适应大学新环境”可知 acclimation 意为“（新生对环境的）适应”，故 [A] adaptation 正确。

questions.stem: A gap year may save money for students by helping them ___.
questions.stem_cn: 通过帮助大学生___，间隔年能够为其节省开支。
questions.explanation: 第四段用研究数据说明间隔年能帮学生更好地确定自身兴趣所在，减少转专业造成的金钱浪费（补学分费用高、甚至多读一年），故 [D] 正确。

questions.stem: The most suitable title for this text would be ___.
questions.stem_cn: 本文最恰当的标题可能是___。

options.A: In Favor of the Gap Year
options.B: The ABCs of the Gap Year

questions.explanation: 首段引出“毕业生完全忽视间隔年”的现象，第二段提出作者观点“间隔年有助于学业成功”，三、四段论证其作用，全文立意在于呼吁重视间隔年的意义，故 [A] 正确。

articles.title: Rethinking How Society Views Fire
articles.topic: 重新看待野火：从公共支出到人与火的共存
articles.source: 2017 年考研英语（二）Text 4 · 原文与答案依据真题及解析 PDF

sentences.en: Though often viewed as a problem for western states, the growing frequency of wildfires is a national concern because of its impact on federal tax dollars, says Professor Max Moritz, a specialist in fire ecology and management.
sentences.cn: 日益频繁的森林大火尽管常常被视为西部州的棘手问题，但由于它对联邦税款的影响而成为一件举国关切之事，林火生态与管理专家马克斯·莫里茨教授说。

sentences.en: In 2015, the US Forest Service for the first time spent more than half of its $5.5 billion annual budget fighting fires - nearly double the percentage it spent on such efforts 20 years ago.
sentences.cn: 2015 年，美国林务局首次将其年度预算总额 55 亿美元中的过半用于抗击林火——几乎是 20 年前在这方面支出比例的两倍。

sentences.en: In effect, fewer federal funds today are going towards the agency's other work - such as forest conservation, watershed and cultural resources management, and infrastructure upkeep - that affect the lives of all Americans.
sentences.cn: 事实上，现在更少的联邦基金被投放到该机构的其他工作，诸如森林保护、集水区及文化资源管理、以及基础设施养护等，这些工作影响到全美国人民的生活。

sentences.en: Another nationwide concern is whether public funds from other agencies are going into construction in fire-prone districts.
sentences.cn: 另一件举国关切之事是，来自其他机构的公共基金是否被用于火灾易发区建设。

sentences.en: As Moritz puts it, how often are federal dollars building homes that are likely to be lost to a wildfire?
sentences.cn: 以莫里茨的话来讲就是，联邦资金用于建设那些可能会被毁于林火的家园的频率如何。

sentences.en: "It's already a huge problem from a public expenditure perspective for the whole country," he says.
sentences.cn: “从公共支出角度看，这对整个国家来说已然是一个巨大的难题，”他说。

sentences.en: "We need to take a magnifying glass to that. Like, 'Wait a minute, is this OK?' Do we want instead to redirect those funds to concentrate on lower-hazard parts of the landscape?"
sentences.cn: “对此，我们要用放大镜来看待。比如，‘等一下，这样做可行吗？’我们是否想反过来，将这些资金重新导向，集中用于地景中危险较低的部分呢？”

sentences.en: Such a view would require a corresponding shift in the way US society today views fire, researchers say.
sentences.cn: 研究者说，这种观念需要当今美国社会在看待火灾的方式上做出相应改变。

sentences.en: For one thing, conversations about wildfires need to be more inclusive.
sentences.cn: 首先，关于森林大火的晤谈应该更具包容性。

sentences.en: Over the past decade, the focus has been on climate change - how the warming of the Earth from greenhouse gases is leading to conditions that worsen fires.
sentences.cn: 在过去的十来年间，晤谈一直聚焦于气候变化——温室气体所致的地球变暖如何诱发使火灾恶化的环境。

sentences.en: While climate is a key element, Moritz says, it shouldn't come at the expense of the rest of the equation.
sentences.cn: 莫里茨说，尽管气候是一个关键要素，但它不应以牺牲其他影响因素作为代价。

sentences.en: "The human systems and the landscapes we live on are linked, and the interactions go both ways," he says.
sentences.cn: “人类系统与我们所赖以生存的地景相互关联，而且，两者间的相互影响是双向的，”他说。

sentences.en: Failing to recognize that, he notes, leads to "an overly simplified view of what the solutions might be. Our perception of the problem and of what the solution is becomes very limited."
sentences.cn: 他指出，不能认识到这一点会导致“对可能的解决措施的看法过于简化，对问题的认知以及对问题解决办法的认知变得极其有限”。

sentences.en: At the same time, people continue to treat fire as an event that needs to be wholly controlled and unleashed only out of necessity, says Professor Balch at the University of Colorado.
sentences.cn: 然而，人们仍旧把火灾视为需要全面控制且唯有必要方可释放的事件，科罗拉多大学鲍尔奇教授说。

sentences.en: But acknowledging fire's inevitable presence in human life is an attitude crucial to developing the laws, policies, and practices that make it as safe as possible, she says.
sentences.cn: 但是，承认火灾在人类生活中的必然存在这一态度对于形成确保火灾尽可能安全的法律、政策、惯例至关重要，她说。

sentences.en: "We've disconnected ourselves from living with fire," Balch says.
sentences.cn: “我们已将自身从与火灾共存中剥离开来，”鲍尔奇说。

sentences.en: "It is really important to understand and try and tease out what is the human connection with fire today."
sentences.cn: “理解并尽力梳理出当今人类与火灾之间的关联非常重要。”

questions.stem: More frequent wildfires have become a national concern because in 2015 they ___.
questions.stem_cn: 森林大火更频繁已成举国关切之事，是因为2015年森林大火___。

options.B: consumed a record-high percentage of budget
options.C: severely damaged the ecology of western states
options.D: caused a huge rise of infrastructure expenditure

options_cn.A: 消耗史无前例的管理力度
options_cn.B: 花费破纪录的高比例预算
options_cn.C: 严重损害西部州的生态
options_cn.D: 造成基础设施支出大幅上升

questions.explanation: 第一段指出野火因对联邦税款的不良影响而成为举国关切之事，第二段①句例证：2015年美国林务局首次将超过一半的预算用于抗击林火（近20年前的两倍），故 [B] 正确。

questions.stem: Moritz calls for the use of "a magnifying glass" to ___.
questions.stem_cn: 莫里茨呼吁使用“放大镜”旨在___。

options.A: raise more funds for fire-prone areas
options.B: avoid the redirection of federal money
options.C: find wildfire-free parts of the landscape
options.D: guarantee safer spending of public funds

options_cn.A: 为火灾易发区募集更多资金
options_cn.B: 避免改变联邦资金的用途
options_cn.C: 寻找该地景林火免疫区
options_cn.D: 确保公共资金的支出更可靠

questions.explanation: 第四段②句指出莫里茨建议用放大镜审视“是否将联邦资金投入林火易发区建设”，③④句以设问方式说明其含义：多提问、多审思，把资金投向低风险区域，即确保联邦资产投向准确无误，故 [D] 正确。

questions.stem: While admitting that climate is a key element, Moritz notes that ___.
questions.stem_cn: 承认气候是关键要素之余，莫里茨也指出___。

options.A: public debates have not settled yet
options.C: other factors should not be overlooked
options.D: a shift in the view of fire has taken place

questions.explanation: 第七段明确指出莫里茨观点：气候尽管是关键要素，但不应以牺牲其他影响因素为代价，即不应忽略其他因素，故 [C] 正确。

questions.stem: The overly simplified view Moritz mentions is a result of failing to ___.
questions.stem_cn: 莫里茨所言及的过度简化的看法是未能___所致。

options.A: discover the fundamental makeup of nature
options.B: explore the mechanism of the human systems
options.C: maximize the role of landscape in human life
options.D: understand the interrelations of man and nature

options_cn.C: 充分发挥地景在人类生活中的作用
options_cn.D: 掌握人类和自然的相互关系

questions.explanation: 第八段先指出人文系统与地景相互关联、相互影响（双向），随后指出不认识这一关系的后果：对解决措施的看法过于简化，故 [D] 掌握人与自然的相互关系正确。

questions.stem: Professor Balch points out that fire is something man should ___.
questions.stem_cn: 鲍尔奇教授指出火灾是人类应该___的事物。
questions.explanation: 第九、十段引用鲍尔奇之言：人们误以为火灾可被全面控制，事实上必须承认火灾不可避免；理解并梳理人与火的关联至关重要。可见其认为人类应与火灾和谐共存、接受其存在，故 [B] come to terms with 正确。
